title: KMS Live Canary Foundation

transitions.note: Created while AWS account setup is deferred so the live KMS verification path can be prepared safely in advance.
Add a server-only reusable canary with no route, no persistence, no AWS call until explicitly invoked with a configured data-key provider.

Full PR CI passed audit, typecheck, lint, unit tests, env/model-verifier tests, build, state/docs checks and smoke; Vercel preview succeeded. Canary directly verifies provider-layer encryption-context rejection rather than relying only on AES-GCM AAD.
Reusable server-only KMS canary foundation completed with no route, persistence, AWS resource, env, OpenRouter or paid-traffic activation.
Reopened after PR review correctly identified that any negative-check error was being treated as proof of context enforcement and that the exported security-sensitive canary contract needed JSDoc.

Review hardening passed full CI. Negative context verification now accepts only AWS KMS InvalidCiphertextException; operational errors fail closed. Exported canary contract is documented with live side effects and error codes.
Both security review threads resolved with regression coverage and AWS-documented error semantics. No live AWS invocation or runtime activation occurred.

notes: Review-hardened KMS canary foundation is ready for later live invocation after AWS/Vercel OIDC setup. No route or persistence activation.
